spec.name: erosita_selection_depth_interaction
spec.inputs: eRASS1 catalogue, depth products, frozen residual
spec.statistic: Residual interaction with exposure, detection and depth strata controlling redshift and mass proxy.
spec.criterion: Apply the frozen SELECTION_COUPLED versus INVARIANT rule.

spec.name: wl_highz_calibrator_hierarchy
spec.inputs: Frozen DES, KiDS and HSC calibrator products with released covariance
spec.statistic: Hierarchical normalization plus high-z trend by survey.
spec.criterion: Apply the frozen CALIBRATOR_TENSION versus CONSISTENT rule.

spec.name: de_microphysics_stage1_stability
spec.inputs: Frozen theory parameter boxes and published constraints; CAMB 1.6.6 where applicable.
spec.statistic: Background and stability diagnostics over the frozen redshift interval.
spec.criterion: Apply each test's frozen stability decision rule.
spec.outputs: stable region, failed conditions and decision
